explanation: Apples cooked in butter and sugar are covered with pastry, baked, then flipped onto a plate. The tart is named after the Tatin sisters, who served it at their hotel in France.

claims.text: A classic tarte Tatin is made with apples, caramelized in butter and sugar under a pastry lid, then turned out upside down.
A classic tarte Tatin is not made with cherries, peaches or plums.
The tarte Tatin is named after the Tatin sisters, who served it at their hotel in Lamotte-Beuvron, France.
